title: “Grow a Spine”: All-In Podcast Pushes Back on AI Regulation and Calls PayPal’s $60 Takeover Offer Just an Opening Bid
title_zh: “Grow a Spine”：All-In Podcast 抵制人工智能监管，并称 PayPal 的 60 美元收购要约只是开盘要约
summary: David Sacks issued a sharp warning to tech executives cozying up to Washington regulators, while investors are already debating whether PayPal's reported takeover offer drastically undersells one of fintech's most contested assets.
summary_zh: 戴维·萨克斯 (David Sacks) 对讨好华盛顿监管机构的科技高管发出了严厉警告，而投资者已经在争论 PayPal 报道的收购要约是否大幅低于金融科技最具争议资产之一的售价。

title: Does US$2.8 Billion in AI Cloud Deals with Tech Giants Change The Bull Case For IREN (IREN)?
title_zh: 与科技巨头的 28 亿美元人工智能云交易是否会改变 IREN (IREN) 的牛市理由？
summary: In July 2026, IREN Limited announced it had secured US$2.80 billion in new multi-year AI cloud services contracts with customers including Microsoft, NVIDIA, and several AI developers, lifting its 2026 AI Cloud annualized run-rate revenue target to more than US$4.00 billion, a...
summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月，IREN Limited 宣布已与微软、NVIDIA 和多家人工智能开发商等客户签订了价值 28 亿美元的新的多年期人工智能云服务合同，将其 2026 年人工智能云年化运行收入目标提升至超过 40 亿美元，...

title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Helps Drive $60 Billion In U.S. Iraq Deals
title_zh: 摩根大通 (JPM) 帮助美国在伊拉克的交易中推动了 600 亿美元的交易
summary: JPMorgan Chase is involved in a series of high profile economic agreements between U.S. companies and Iraq tied to the Iraqi Prime Minister’s recent visit to Washington.
summary_zh: 摩根大通参与了美国公司与伊拉克之间与伊拉克总理最近访问华盛顿有关的一系列备受瞩目的经济协议。

title: AMD stock rises on price target bumps, Microsoft deal
title_zh: AMD 股价因目标价上涨和微软交易而上涨
summary: AMD stock rose more than 3% on Monday.
summary_zh: AMD 股价周一上涨超过 3%。

title: Blackstone Backs Futronic in Deal Valuing Robotics Supplier at $675 Million
title_zh: Blackstone 在机器人供应商交易中支持 Futronic，估值达 6.75 亿美元
summary: Private equity investment supports Futronic's global expansion as Blackstone highlights AI, robotics and automotive growth opportunities.
summary_zh: Blackstone 强调人工智能、机器人和汽车增长机会，私募股权投资支持 Futronic 的全球扩张。
